free_tier.stated: a disposable inbox with a 40 MB quota, created and read over a keyless REST API

per_object_cap.stated: 40 MB quota per inbox, reported by the account object

retention.stated: messages persist until the account is deleted; no expiry is stated

chaining: the verification-code sink, measured end to end: create an inbox with no key, let a service deliver over SMTP, read the message back over the API. The scarce link is the 40 MB quota and the single shared domain.

limits.value: no published rate limit; the API is undocumented beyond the Hydra index
40 MB quota per inbox, reported by the account object

identity_cost.detail: no key, no email verification and no card; measured by creating an account

reliability_note: one active domain; a domain change would invalidate every address a script had recorded

evidence.proved: 200, one active domain maxxspace.com (id 6aa6b995482bea6f4a97f585, isActive true), read with no key
201, a fresh account with quota 40000000, used 0, isDisabled false; no email verification and no card
200, a 360-character JWT for the new account
EHLO returned 250 and an SMTP message to the created address was accepted; sendmail returned no refusal
200, the message listed with its subject and sender, then GET /messages/{id} returned 200 with subject, from, a text part and an html part

notes: Four requests and one SMTP message proved the whole chain. 25 MiB per message against a 40 MB inbox is the practical ceiling, so one inbox holds one message.
interface_detail: /domains, /accounts, /token and /messages on api.mail.tm; SMTP delivery to in.mail.tm
